VBO:0201282.summary: Spitz is a broad dog type, often marked by upright ears and a dense coat. Its members have varied histories: Malamutes hauled heavy sled loads, Finnish Spitz located game birds, and Samoyeds worked with northern herders.
VBO:0201282.shortDescription: Spitz-type breeds have varied hunting, herding and sled-working histories; they are not one breed.

sources.title: AKC — Get to Know the Spitz Breeds
